Source and measurement

The source is the saved City-traffic-M payload for Yekaterinburg on 2024-10-18, from mightyneghbor/city-traffic-benchmarks, source version 4. The source files are city-traffic-M-raw-volume.parquet and city-traffic-M-raw-static-features.parquet. The bundled cache retains the 720 supplied segment records and the saved volume arrays from city_traffic_M_osm_congestion_sample.json.

Each saved frame represents the source’s mean of three five-minute observations. The preparation performs no further temporal aggregation or segment selection. The physical volume unit is not established by this payload, so values retain the label source volume; they are not converted to vehicles/hour or capacity ratios. No speed-derived congestion index is used.

Data preparation

data/source.rds contains the selected source-level records and supplied geometry. prepare.R converts them to the common input without downloading data. Its executed implementation appears in Appendix A. The generated data/input.rds is then read by the common package.

library(bdynets)
source("prepare.R")
prepared_file <- prepare_example(".")
x <- read_traffic(prepared_file)
input <- readRDS(prepared_file)
index <- match(params$time_label,sub("^.* ","",x$time_labels))
stopifnot(!is.na(index))

The map starts at 2024-10-18 08:00 and covers 15 minutes. The default 08:00 is a demonstration selection, not a maximum-based selection. Numeric seconds and displayed labels retain the supplied source clock; they do not establish a UTC offset.

A road-time cell is one road in one interval. These counts cover the whole day, including roads outside the central-area map view. An omitted pair and an explicit NA are missing; neither is replaced by zero.

Selected-time map and statistics

plot(x,index=index)

Saved source-volume observations at the selected fifteen-minute interval. The map focuses on the central spatial range; all 720 supplied segments enter the statistics.

The common log1p algorithm uses all supplied values to establish the day’s thresholds. Red means higher source volume, not a verified congested state. Speed-limit and maximum-volume attributes do not choose a plotting style.

Daily pattern and limits

trend <- traffic_trend(x)
plot(trend$time,trend$mean,type="l",lwd=2,col="#365c70",xaxt="n",
     xlab="Source time",ylab=paste("Mean [",x$unit,"]"))
at <- unique(round(seq(1,nrow(trend),length.out=7)))
axis(1,at=trend$time[at],labels=sub("^.* ","",trend$label[at]))
abline(v=x$times[index],lty=2,col="#7b858b")

Mean of available road values in each interval. The dashed line marks the selected map time. 

peak <- which.max(trend$mean)

The greatest mean over the supplied segments is 38.22 at 2024-10-18 13:00. All 69,120 road-frame values are present. The observations cover the supplied segment selection, not all city roads. The unknown physical unit prevents a direct magnitude comparison with Beijing or PeMS hourly rates. No event table is supplied.

Figure and data export

The common traffic_export() interface writes PNG/PDF maps and applicable trends, exact selected records, summary and trend tables, source metadata, input/output MD5 checksums and session information. selected-frame.rds retains the full input’s color thresholds and unit for inspection; it is not a new input bundle. Existing output directories are refused. The report parameter export defaults to false, so normal rendering creates no export folder.

if(params$export) {
  label <- gsub("[^[:alnum:]_-]+","-",x$time_labels[index])
  traffic_export(x,file.path(params$export_dir,label),index=index,
    input_files=c(source="data/source.rds",prepared="data/input.rds"))
}

Basemap source

The figures use the supplied offline OSM-derived context. Basemap build dates identify the context snapshot, independently of the traffic date or simulation day. Generalized map features are suitable for display, not a routable road graph. Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors; basemap extraction uses Protomaps archives distributed as ODbL Produced Works.

Appendix A: preparation implementation

The following code is the source-to-input transformation executed from prepare.R. The input cache supplies all objects used by this function.

prepare_example <- function(base=".", source_file="data/source.rds", output_file="data/input.rds") {
  base <- normalizePath(base, mustWork=TRUE)
  source_path <- file.path(base, source_file)
  s <- readRDS(source_path)
  stopifnot(identical(s$schema, "metropolis-volume-frames-v1"))
  roads <- s$road_attributes
  ids <- vapply(s$segments, function(z) as.character(z$id), "")
  stopifnot(identical(ids, as.character(roads$id)))
  roads$road_id <- ids
  roads$geometry <- lapply(s$segments, function(z)
    rbind(c(z$lon1, z$lat1), c(z$lon2, z$lat2)))
  volume <- vapply(s$frames, function(z) as.numeric(z$volume), numeric(length(ids)))
  labels <- vapply(s$frames, function(z) z$time, "")
  stopifnot(identical(labels, s$settings$time_labels), ncol(volume) == 96L,
            all(is.na(volume) | (is.finite(volume) & volume >= 0)))
  flow <- data.frame(road_id=rep(ids, ncol(volume)),
    time=rep(s$settings$times, each=length(ids)), flow=as.vector(volume))
  events <- NULL
  s$settings$provenance$preparation_check <- list(source_segments=length(ids),
    source_frames=length(s$frames), road_frame_values=length(volume),
    added_temporal_aggregation=FALSE, physical_unit_verified=FALSE)
  input <- c(list(schema="trafficmap-input-v1", roads=roads, flow=flow, events=events), s$settings)
  input$provenance$source_cache <- list(file=basename(source_file),
    bytes=unname(file.info(source_path)$size), md5=unname(tools::md5sum(source_path)), schema=s$schema)
  stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(roads$road_id), all(flow$road_id %in% roads$road_id),
            !anyDuplicated(flow[c("road_id", "time")]),
            all(is.na(flow$flow) | (is.finite(flow$flow) & flow$flow >= 0)))
  bdynets::traffic_data(roads=roads, flow=flow, events=events,
    times=input$times, time_labels=input$time_labels, interval_seconds=input$interval_seconds,
    unit=if(is.null(input$unit)) "unit unspecified" else input$unit,
    basemap=input$basemap)
  output <- file.path(base, output_file)
  dir.create(dirname(output), recursive=TRUE, showWarnings=FALSE)
  saveRDS(input, output, compress="xz", version=3)
  invisible(output)
}
if(sys.nframe()==0L) {
  script <- sub("^--file=", "", grep("^--file=", commandArgs(FALSE), value=TRUE))
  if(length(script)!=1L) stop("Rscript entrypoint is required")
  if(!file.exists(script)) script <- gsub("~+~", " ", script, fixed=TRUE)
  prepare_example(dirname(normalizePath(script, mustWork=TRUE)))
  cat("Prepared data/input.rds\n")
}
